tier_labels.2: Music unit of an arts university

meta.scope_text: Included are holders of the Erasmus Charter for Higher Education (ECHE) where music is an independent degree-awarding institution or the music unit of an arts university. Music departments of general universities are not yet included. Data retrieved 20 September 2026 from the European Commission's ECHE list. Institutions in the United Kingdom and Switzerland will be added once they have been awarded an ECHE (association with Erasmus+ from 1 January 2027).
meta.partner_source: Partner information is taken from the exchange-destination list published by the University of the Arts Helsinki.
